title: Acorn Hill Solitaire
short: Clear wooden cards off an autumn hill, one up or one down. A new hill opens every day.
desc:
Wooden cards lie stacked across an autumn hill. Tap a card one higher or one lower than the top card in the basket and it flies over. 13 wraps around to 1.

· Only cards with nothing on top can be taken. Clear a card and the ones beneath flip over.
· Chains score more. When nothing fits, flip a card from the stock.
· Once per hill, the squirrel throws an acorn to clear any open card.
· Every deal is checked to be winnable without help before you get it.

Hill Map
Thirty hills in five shapes. Win with more stock left to earn more stars.

Today's Hill
A new hill opens every day. Everyone gets the same deal on the same day.

Squirrel's Winter Store
Acorns from every hill fill the squirrel's winter store with twelve cozy things, from an acorn jar and a mushroom lamp to a knitted scarf.

Leaderboard
Pick a nickname to put your best score on the weekly and all-time boards (optional).

· Close the app and your hill is still there
· Sound and music toggle with one button

A short ad may appear between rounds (at most once every 2.5 minutes). No purchases, no sign-in.

This game was planned and built with the help of AI tools.
